title: Aoyagi Toya — Amid Unchanging Warmth〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Tsukasa and Saki's party is happening this week.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Kamishiro even said that my cupcakes were good. All that's left is for me to bake more for the day of.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Practice ended early today, so I should take this opportunity to buy whatever ingredients I need.)

rows.Speaker: Customer
rows.Line: Thanks for the pancakes! They were delicious! I'll come back again real soon!

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: Yeah, we'll be waiting!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, it's that cafe...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Akito goes there from time to time.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, that cafe.
They added new pancakes to their menu again?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “We proudly present our latest and most odd pancakes”...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, what do you think they mean by “odd”?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, I think they're referring to how delicate the batter is.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Each individual pancake ends up looking unique because they all rise differently.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wait, doesn't that mean some will turn out well while others won't look as nice? That seems a bit unfair to the customers...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nah, they're pros when it comes to that. Regardless of how they look, they all taste good.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: However, there are people out there who only care about getting the best-looking one. Like Ena...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't really care how they look as long as they taste good. They're kind of like shows, you know?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Like shows?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, because they whip up the best pancakes they can for each individual customer at that point in time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Apparently, how they turn out depends on what kind of condition the batter's ingredients are in that day, the temperature, level of humidity and all sorts of other things.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Doesn't that kinda sound like one of our events?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Like one of our events...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, the batter is the performer? And they're using the information they can only learn that day, like the temperature and humidity, to get the crowd going?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Exactly.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I remember how KAITO compared us to pancakes when we were getting ready for one of our events...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And in retrospect, he was right for a change.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: For a change? That's not a very nice thing to say.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, it's his fault for acting the way he usually does.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, that place's “odd” pancakes are made with each individual customer in mind.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Since we're here and done practicing for the day, wanna go get some? They even have some that aren't all that sweet.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we should invite the others as well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Odd creations that come from the heart...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Why not try thinking about the happiest thing they ever did for you when you were little?

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, I'm going to turn Toya's frown upside down by doing a show for him!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
His shows are really fun!
You'll be smiling from ear to ear after watching it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Back then, they made me smile so many times. Even now...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And now, it's my turn to...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Miku, KAITO and Kamishiro... For the sake of all those who helped me, I need to do my absolute best.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll grab whatever ingredients I need, go over the recipe again and review the entire process. After that...
